exports.description: Create a `NetSocket` and connect it over IPC if a `path` is given, otherwise over TCP.

params.name: path
params.description: - The path to connect to over IPC.

params.name: opts
params.description: - Options for the socket and connection; if `path` is set the socket connects over IPC, otherwise over TCP.

params.name: onconnect
params.description: - Called when the connection is established.

exports.name: NetOptions
exports.description: Options accepted when constructing a `NetSocket` or `NetServer`.

members.name: allowHalfOpen
members.description: Keep the writable side of the socket open after the readable side ends. Defaults to `false`.

members.name: eagerOpen
members.description: Open the socket immediately instead of waiting for the first write. Defaults to `false`.

members.name: readBufferSize
members.description: Size, in bytes, of the socket's internal read buffer. Defaults to `65536`.

signatures:
interface NetSocket<M extends NetSocketEvents = NetSocketEvents> {

  readonly pending: boolean

  readonly readyState: 'open' | 'readOnly' | 'writeOnly' | 'opening'
  readonly localAddress?: string
  readonly localPort?: number
  readonly localFamily?: string
  readonly remoteAddress?: string
  readonly remotePort?: number
  readonly remoteFamily?: string
  connect(path: string, opts?: PipeConnectOptions, onconnect?: () => void): this
  setKeepAlive(enable?: boolean, delay?: number): this
  setNoDelay(enable?: boolean): this
  setTimeout(ms: number, ontimeout?: () => void): this
  ref(): this
  unref(): this
  _open(cb: StreamCallback): void
  _predestroy(): void
  _destroy(err: Error | null, cb: StreamCallback): void
  readonly readable: boolean
  readonly writable: boolean
  readonly destroyed: boolean
  readonly destroying: boolean
  destroy(err?: Error | null): void
  _read(size: number): void
  readonly closed: boolean
  readonly errored: Error | null
  push(data: unknown | null, encoding?: BufferEncoding): boolean
  unshift(data: unknown | null, encoding?: BufferEncoding): boolean
  read(): unknown | null
  resume(): this
  pause(): this
  pipe<S extends Writable>(dest: S, cb?: StreamCallback): S
  setEncoding(encoding: BufferEncoding): void
  _write(data: unknown, encoding: StreamEncoding, cb: StreamCallback): void
  _writev(batch: { chunk: unknown; encoding: StreamEncoding }[], cb: StreamCallback): void
  _final(cb: StreamCallback): void
  write(data: unknown, encoding?: BufferEncoding, cb?: StreamCallback): boolean
  end(cb?: StreamCallback): this
  cork(): void
  uncork(): void
}

members.description: Connect the socket to a `path` over IPC, or to a `port`/`host` over TCP.

params.name: path
params.description: - The path to connect to over IPC.

params.name: opts
params.description: - Connection options passed to the underlying socket; `path`, `port`, and `host` may be given here instead of as positional arguments.

params.name: onconnect
params.description: - Called once when the socket emits `'connect'`.

members.name: connecting
members.description: `true` while the underlying socket is in the process of connecting.

members.name: localAddress
members.description: Local IP address the socket is connected on, if connected over TCP.

members.name: localFamily
members.description: Local IP address family, if connected over TCP.

members.name: localPort
members.description: Local port the socket is connected on, if connected over TCP.

members.name: pending
members.description: `true` if the socket hasn't been assigned an underlying TCP or IPC socket yet.

members.name: readyState
members.description: Current connection state of the socket.

members.name: ref
members.description: Reference the socket, keeping the event loop alive while it is open.

members.name: remoteAddress
members.description: Remote IP address the socket is connected to, if connected over TCP.

members.name: remoteFamily
members.description: Remote IP address family, if connected over TCP.

members.name: remotePort
members.description: Remote port the socket is connected to, if connected over TCP.

members.name: setKeepAlive
members.description: Enable or disable TCP keep-alive on the underlying socket.

members.name: setNoDelay
members.description: Enable or disable Nagle's algorithm on the underlying socket.

members.name: setTimeout
members.description: Set the socket's inactivity timeout.

members.name: timeout
members.description: The socket's current inactivity timeout, in milliseconds.

members.name: unref
members.description: Unreference the socket, allowing the event loop to exit while it is open.
